```{r}
data_all <- updated_analysis_three_domain
# Filter for high-ability students
data <- data_all[data_all$high_ability == "2", ]
```


```{r}
data$SCSY_2_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_2
data$SCSY_3_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_3
data$SCSY_5_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_5
data$SCSY_7_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_7
data$SCSY_10_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_10
data$SCSY_12_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_12
data$SCSY_14_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_14
data$SCSY_16_rev <- 6 - data$SCSY_16

# Calculate subscales
data$self_kindness <- (data$SCSY_1 + data$SCSY_9 + data$SCSY_15) / 3
data$self_judgment <- (data$SCSY_3_rev + data$SCSY_7_rev + data$SCSY_12_rev) / 3
data$common_humanity <- (data$SCSY_4 + data$SCSY_8 + data$SCSY_13) / 3
data$isolation <- (data$SCSY_2_rev + data$SCSY_10_rev + data$SCSY_16_rev) / 3
data$mindfulness <- (data$SCSY_6 + data$SCSY_11 + data$SCSY_17) / 3
data$over_identification <- (data$SCSY_5_rev + data$SCSY_5_rev) / 2

# Calculate total score
data$total_score_SCSY <- (data$self_kindness + data$self_judgment + 
                    data$common_humanity + data$isolation + 
                    data$mindfulness + data$over_identification) / 6

data$SCSY_normalized <- scale(data$total_score_SCSY)
data$daydreaming_normalized1 <- scale(data$dysphoric_dd)
data$daydreaming_normalized2 <- scale(data$Positive_dd)
data$daydreaming_normalized3 <- scale(data$attention_control)
```

```{r}
# Recode the values: 1 -> 0 (no) and 2 -> 1 (yes)
data$sub_under <- factor(data$sub_under, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("0", "1"))
data$obj_under <- factor(data$obj_under, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("0", "1"))
```

```{r}
evaluate_predictions <- function(predicted, actual) {
    # Create confusion matrix
    conf_matrix <- table(Predicted = predicted, Actual = actual)
    
    # Calculate accuracy
    accuracy <- sum(diag(conf_matrix)) / sum(conf_matrix)
    
    # Print results
    print("Confusion Matrix:")
    print(conf_matrix)
    print(paste("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3)))
}
```




```{r}
# Check class distribution in the full filtered dataset
table(data$sub_under)
table(data$obj_under)
```



```{r}
# Split data into training and testing sets (80-20 split)
set.seed(123)

# Create the split
split <- sample.split(data$sub_under, SplitRatio = 0.8)

# Create training and testing datasets
train_data <- data[split, ]
test_data <- data[!split, ]
```


```{r}
# Create model formulas
formula_sub <- sub_under ~ SCSY_normalized + daydreaming_normalized1 + daydreaming_normalized2 + daydreaming_normalized3
formula_obj <- obj_under ~ SCSY_normalized + daydreaming_normalized1 + daydreaming_normalized2 + daydreaming_normalized3

# Train logistic regression models
model_sub_log <- glm(formula_sub, data = train_data, family = "binomial")
model_obj_log <- glm(formula_obj, data = train_data, family = "binomial")

# Train random forest models
model_sub_rf <- randomForest(formula_sub, data = train_data)
model_obj_rf <- randomForest(formula_obj, data = train_data)

# Model evaluation
# For logistic regression
pred_sub_log <- predict(model_sub_log, test_data, type = "response")
pred_obj_log <- predict(model_obj_log, test_data, type = "response")

# Convert probabilities to class predictions (threshold = 0.5)
pred_class_sub_log <- ifelse(pred_sub_log > 0.5, "1", "0")
pred_class_obj_log <- ifelse(pred_obj_log > 0.5, "1", "0")

# Calculate accuracy and other metrics
confusionMatrix(factor(pred_class_sub_log), test_data$sub_under)
confusionMatrix(factor(pred_class_obj_log), test_data$obj_under)
```


```{r}
# For random forest
pred_sub_rf <- predict(model_sub_rf, test_data)
pred_obj_rf <- predict(model_obj_rf, test_data)
```

```{r}
# Create a simple evaluation function
evaluate_model <- function(predicted, actual) {
    conf_matrix <- table(Predicted = predicted, Actual = actual)
    accuracy <- sum(diag(conf_matrix)) / sum(conf_matrix)
    
    # Calculate additional metrics
    true_pos <- conf_matrix[2,2]
    false_pos <- conf_matrix[2,1]
    true_neg <- conf_matrix[1,1]
    false_neg <- conf_matrix[1,2]
    
    sensitivity <- true_pos / (true_pos + false_neg)
    specificity <- true_neg / (true_neg + false_pos)
    
    # Return results
    cat("Confusion Matrix:\n")
    print(conf_matrix)
    cat("\nModel Performance Metrics:\n")
    cat("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3), "\n")
    cat("Sensitivity:", round(sensitivity, 3), "\n")
    cat("Specificity:", round(specificity, 3), "\n")
}

# Apply to your random forest predictions
evaluate_model(pred_sub_rf, test_data$sub_under)
```
```{r}
evaluate_model(pred_obj_rf, test_data$sub_under)
```

```{r}
confusionMatrix(pred_sub_rf, test_data$sub_under)
confusionMatrix(pred_obj_rf, test_data$obj_under)
```
